facts: Asking SGD688, page state Reserved. Title says In Stock; description ready stock. Record contradiction, no current availability claim.
Seller claims brand new, limited numbered 1000. Exact physical number, signatures, size, provenance, authenticity, completeness and edition release date unverified.
Seller describes Orchard Central #06-21 Singapore store and free shipping within Singapore. Physical item location and dispatch origin not confirmed; no Mainland shipping fee/promise.
Seller terms disclaim product/package defects and say no refund/exchange except broken/missing parts. This is seller text, not independent legal enforceability finding.
Likes, reviews and 20 seller-wide Orders are not target item sales. No transaction price/date/buyer country.
